mentions.name: TinyTelco
mentions.description: An analog telephone line simulator built almost entirely from CMOS and through-hole parts, acting like a rudimentary PBX you can build at home — a little telephone company that sits on your desk. It is designed so other people can reproduce the build.
mentions.problem: It is the first design of its kind from the 21st century with any hope of being reproduced by others.
mentions.audience: Electronics hobbyists and home builders who want to reproduce it
mentions.source_excerpt: An analog telephone line simulator built (almost) entirely in CMOS and through-hole parts. It will be the second of its kind designed entirely in the 21st century, and the first of its kind designed in the 21st century with any hope of other people reproducing it. Think of it like a rudimentary PBX you can build at home, or like a little telephone company that sits on your desk.
